messages:
ryan: Heads up — CI perf-microbench failed on PR #10456. Batch-window latency up ~18% vs goldens, kv cache hitrate down ~6%. ci-bot posted the diffs: <ci/reports/10456/perf-diff>
ci-bot: [perf-microbench] threshold-diff: batch_window_latency: +18.3% (threshold 10%), kv_cache_hitrate: -6.1% (threshold -3%) — job: perf-microbench/x86-rt64 — logs: <ci/logs/10456>

sasha: Ugh. I think this may be the kernel-autoselect tweak from my last commit (commit: a3f9b2c). It changed the cost model for short sequences and could bias toward faster kernels that have worse batching behavior.

maya: I reproduced locally with the microbench harness. Running with env VARS: BATCHER_DEBUG=1, RT_MODE=on, I see batch windows consistently 2-3ms longer at 95th. Quick profiler trace attached below.

olga: Can you paste the profiler snippet? I want to check KV cache read hotpath.

maya: ```
# perf top snapshot (hot functions)
0.45%  runtime::kernel_selector::choose_kernel
0.38%  runtime::batcher::wait_for_batch
0.34%  runtime::kv_cache::lookup
0.28%  kernels::fused_attention::compute
```

sasha: That lines up. choose_kernel moved to prefer small-seq kernels that avoid prefetching, but those kernels return control differently and block the batcher longer. KV lookup drop maybe secondary because more batch fragmentation -> less prefix reuse.

ryan: Can we bisect to confirm? Plan: revert the autoselect heuristic temporarily on CI (quick revert PR), and run the microbench job. If revert fixes, open a follow-up to rework heuristics with batch-awareness.

olga: I can run a local bisect over the last 6 commits on the branch. Which CI config to use? perf-microbench/x86-rt64 + nightlies? Also want to capture kv telemetry: set KV_TELEMETRY=1.

sasha: Use the exact job from CI: perf-microbench/x86-rt64 with fixtures/seqlen-dist-rt.json. I pushed a debug variant to my fork: `sasha/perf-debug-10456` — includes extra tracing.

maya: Quick note: the threshold diffs are reproducible on both GPU types (v100, a100) but magnitude varies. Suggest we run the bisect across both to see if kernel selection changes are architecture-specific.

perf-bot: Scheduled: bisect job queued (id: bisect-10456-1). Will run commits: a948..a3f9b2c. Notifying results here when done.

ryan: If bisect pins it to sasha's kernel-change, please cut the revert and mark as rollout-blocker. We'll freeze merges until we have a patch that preserves batching behavior.

sasha: Agreed. If it's my change, I'll prep a revert immediately. I'll also start a branch to add an explicit batch-awareness term to the kernel cost model.

olga: I'll collect kv cache hit-rate traces before/after for the bisected commits and attach to the bisect results.

ryan: Thanks — keep updates short. :thumbsup:
